summary: NanaOn-Sha's experimental music-and-image-driven series, beginning with Vib-Ribbon's CD-generated rhythm stages and followed by Japan-only PS2 successors.

entries.title: Vib-Ribbon

emulation.emulator: PS3 PSOne Classic; DuckStation for archival PlayStation comparison
emulation.notes: Use PS3 if custom audio-CD stages matter.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PSOne Classic output on PS3, with original vector presentation preserved.

primary.why: The PS3 PSOne Classic is the best official modern route because PlayStation Blog says the PS3 version retains the custom audio-CD level feature, while the PSN release also finally made the game broadly available outside its original Japan/Europe-only PlayStation release.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 PSOne Classic release if owned, especially for custom CD-generated stages. Use original PlayStation hardware or DuckStation with a disc image only for archival comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation release in Japan and Europe.
all_releases.reason: skip: original and historically important, but PS3 PSOne Classic is the better accessible route and preserves custom audio-CD stages.

all_releases.fidelity: PSOne Classic digital release on PS3, with custom audio-CD stage generation retained.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS3 PSOne Classic route preserves the defining custom-CD feature while improving access.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PSN release is an emulated PSOne Classic, not a remaster; PSP/Vita compatibility is useful but does not preserve the PS3 custom-CD use case.

entries.title: Mojib-Ribbon

emulation.notes: Use original PS2 for native hardware or PCSX2 for capture/upscaling.

primary.why: Mojib-Ribbon was released only in Japan for PlayStation 2, and no official port or remaster is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PS2 disc on original PS2 hardware or via PCSX2 for capture; expect Japanese rap/calligraphy-focused play.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Only the Japanese PS2 release is documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster or international release is documented.

entries.title: Vib-Ripple

emulation.notes: Use original PS2 for native hardware or PCSX2 for capture/upscaling; verify image-import behavior before a full capture run.

primary.why: Vib-Ripple was released only in Japan for PlayStation 2, uses imported photographs as stages, and has no documented official port or remaster.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Japanese PS2 disc on original PS2 hardware or via PCSX2 for capture; use image-import features where supported.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform and complete release.
